description.value: Hawthorne Beer Market & Bistro is Cloverdale's original craft beer house, established in 2014 and proudly 100% Canadian owned. The pub pours an extensive rotating lineup of BC and Pacific Northwest craft beers on tap alongside bottles and cans sourced from around the world, with a full food menu including burgers, nachos, and seasonal specials. Part of the Pacific Northcoast Restaurant Group, it welcomes both reservations and walk-ins seven days a week.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully loaded with rich content confirming the business is open, operating at 5633 176th Street in Cloverdale (a community within Surrey). Phone (604) 576-5666 and website URL match OSM exactly. The website navigation includes a 'Take Out' page, confirming takeout is offered. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging, or other cyclist amenities anywhere in the fetched content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM addr:city lists 'Surrey' while website uses 'Cloverdale, BC'; Cloverdale is a community within the City of Surrey so these refer to the same location, but the website address is more locally precise.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-documented pub and bistro with a live website, confirmed hours, and full menu — a useful food and drink stop for touring cyclists in Cloverdale.
